ad1.ad1_carries_digest_container: An AD1 carries no digest of the container, so there is nothing to compare these with. Every file inside it does carry one, and those are checked per file.
ad1.ad1_segment_magic_missing: Not an AD1: the segment magic is missing.
ad1.chunk_table_r_runs: The chunk table for %r runs past the end of the image.
ad1.first_source_root_object: The first source's root object is missing.
ad1.logical_image_header_runs_past: The logical image header at offset 0x%X is cut short before its own fields end.
ad1.segment_header_runs_past: The segment header is cut short before its own fields end.
ad1.image_says_d_segments: The image says it has %d segments and %d were found beside it (%s). A missing segment does not read as an error further in — it reads as files that end early and hash to the wrong value.
ad1.object_r_declares_d: Object %r declares %d chunks for %d bytes, which cannot be right.
ad1.segment_d_d_open: This is segment %d of %d. Open the first segment; the rest are found beside it.
ad1.segment_header_ad1_but: The segment header is an AD1 but no logical image follows it at offset 0x%X.
ad1.segment_header_length_d: The segment header length (%d) is not usable.
bitlocker.elephant_diffuser_support_impl: Elephant diffuser support is not implemented. Vista and Windows 7 volumes encrypted with it are identified but not decrypted.
bitlocker.encryption_key_entry_metadata: No encryption key entry in the metadata.
bitlocker.encryption_method_x_x: Encryption method 0x%04X is not supported; the volume will not be decrypted rather than decrypted wrongly.
bitlocker.key_blob_too_short: Key blob is too short to be AES-CCM wrapped.
bitlocker.nothing_volume_accepts_kind: Nothing on this volume accepts that kind of secret. Protectors present: %s.
bitlocker.opened_volume_master_key: The %s opened the volume master key, but the encryption key did not verify. The metadata may be inconsistent.
bitlocker.unwrapped_key_entry_too: Unwrapped key entry is too short.
bitlocker.volume_uses_elephant_diffuser: This volume uses the Elephant diffuser and no tweak key was recovered; it will not be decrypted rather than decrypted wrongly.
carve.custom.bad_byte: The pattern cannot be read at “%s”. Write bytes as hex pairs, ?? for any byte, and ASCII text in double quotes.
carve.custom.bad_choice: “%s” has a value this version does not know.
carve.custom.bad_ext: The extension must be 1 to %d letters or digits.
carve.custom.bad_footer_extra: The bytes kept after the footer must be a whole number from %d to %d.
carve.custom.bad_header_offset: The header offset must be a whole number of bytes from %d to %d.
carve.custom.bad_id: The signature's identifier is not valid.
carve.custom.bad_max_size: The maximum size must be from %d to %d bytes.
carve.custom.bad_name: Give the signature a name of up to %d characters.
carve.custom.footer_ends_wild: A footer must start and end with a known byte, not ??.
carve.custom.footer_too_long: A footer can be at most %d bytes.
carve.custom.header_starts_wild: A header must start with a known byte, not ??.
carve.custom.header_too_long: A header can be at most %d bytes.
carve.custom.header_too_short: A header needs at least two known bytes. Fewer would match almost everywhere.
carve.custom.not_ascii: Only plain ASCII can be quoted in a pattern: “%s”. Write other bytes in hex.
casedb.artefact_reset_reason: stored by an earlier version of the parser; re-run to read them with the current one
casedb.artefact_too_large_reason: not stored; re-run it in a later session rather than reading a truncated copy
casedb.evidence_removed_note: The exhibit and everything recorded against it were deleted from the case. The evidence file itself is untouched.
casedb.index_relocated: The content index moved out of the case record and into the cache folder beside it. It is derived from the evidence and can be deleted and rebuilt at any time.
casedb.index_reset_reason: content index schema updated to record media offsets, region kind and which exhibit each hit came from; rebuild required
casedb.not_a_case: %s is not a Strata case, so it was left untouched. A case is a folder holding case.sqlite; choose that folder, or start a new case.
ewf.chunk_table_found_evidence: No chunk table found; evidence set may be incomplete.
ewf.ewf_v2_ex01_detected: EWF v2 (Ex01) detected. The v2 reader is a separate code path and is not wired up in this build.
logical.folder_not_image: A folder, not an image. There is no container to hash, no sectors to carve and no unallocated space -- the evidence is the files themselves, and each has its own hash.
logical.no_container_to_hash: A folder has no container to hash. Hash the files instead: every file in the collection can be hashed and listed from the hashing tool.
logical.note: Logical evidence: files that were handed over, not a copy of media. There is no volume behind this, so nothing here is carved, there is no unallocated space and no slack, and no file's position on any original disk is recorded. Nothing is marked deleted because this cannot say what was not collected.
logical.zip_members_capped: The archive names %d entries; the first %d are listed. What is not shown is not absent from the archive.
logical.zip_unsafe_name: A stored name climbs out of the archive or is not a plain relative path: %r. It is listed under a safe name; the name the archive really holds is on the item.
luks.argon2_slow_note: Slot %d uses Argon2 with %d MiB of memory and %d passes. Deriving its key in Python takes on the order of tens of seconds per attempt; that is the memory-hard cost, not a fault.
luks.cbc_iv_mode_r: CBC IV mode %r is not supported.
luks.cipher_r_supported_only: Cipher %r is not supported; only AES is.
luks.every_key_slot_volume: Every key slot on this volume is empty. There is no password that opens it.
luks.incorrect_password_all_d: Incorrect password for all %d active key slot%s.
luks.key_material_slot_d: Key material for slot %d is outside the image.
luks.backup_header_used: The primary LUKS2 metadata area was unreadable; the backup copy was used.
luks.no_digest_slot: Slot %d has no digest to verify a recovered key against; it was not used.
luks.kdf_slot_d_unsupported: Slot %d names KDF %r, which is not supported here.
nativedialog.dialog_could_not_open: The file dialog could not be opened.
nativedialog.file_dialog_open_d: The file dialog was open for %d seconds without an answer. If the interface is not on the same machine as the engine, the dialog opened on the engine's screen.
report.attack.intro: Attributed against the %s catalogue%s. An attribution records an examiner's interpretation of a finding; it is not produced by the software.
report.attack.proposed_many: %d attributions the software suggested and no examiner has confirmed. They are listed for completeness and should not be read as findings.
report.attack.proposed_one: 1 attribution the software suggested and no examiner has confirmed. It is listed for completeness and should not be read as a finding.
report.audit.broken_detail: First mismatch at sequence %s. Entries from that point on cannot be relied upon.
report.audit.intact_detail: %d entries, each hashed with the one before it.
report.col.label: Label
report.col.name: Name
report.empty.evidence: No evidence recorded in this case.
report.ev.mismatch: MISMATCH — the image does not hash to what it says it does
report.ev.no_stored_hash: no stored hash in the container
report.footer: Produced by %s. Times are UTC%s. This report is a rendering of the case file at %s; the case file itself remains the record.
report.held.many: %d further bookmarks are recorded in the case and marked as not for this report. They are working marks, not findings that have been withheld; they remain in the case file and in the audit log.
report.held.one: One further bookmark is recorded in the case and marked as not for this report. It is a working mark, not a finding that has been withheld; it remains in the case file and in the audit log.
report.note.audit: Every action taken in this case, in order. Each row is hashed together with the previous row's hash, so altering any entry breaks every link after it. This is the whole log, not a summary.
report.note.hashes: Hashes are those the container itself records. "Verified" means the media was re-read and re-hashed inside this examination; anything else is the container's own claim, untested.
report.note.no_index: No content index was built for this case, so keyword results quoted here came from live searches of the filesystem at the time they were run.
report.refuse_overwrite: %s already exists and is not a report; refusing to overwrite it.
report.subtitle: Examination report · generated %s
server.archive.archive_ceiling_opening_o: Archive is %s; the ceiling for opening one in memory is %s. Export it and open it separately.
server.artefacts.case_file_so_nothing: No case file, so nothing is kept between sessions.
server.artifacts.cost_what_will_take: Cost is what it will take against this image, not a general claim. Anything long keeps running in the background while you work elsewhere.
server.attack_import.could_read_as_stix: Could not read that as a STIX bundle: %s
server.attack_tag.r_att_ck_technique: %r is not an ATT&CK technique id — they look like T1547 or T1547.001.
server.carve.bad_types: The file types to carve for must be a list of extensions.
server.carve.nothing_selected: Choose at least one file type or custom signature to carve for.
server.carve.too_many_custom: At most %d custom signatures can be used in one carve.
server.case_forget.removed_from_list_onl: Removed from this list only. The case file was not touched.
server.case_new.path_new_case: No path for the new case.
server.case_new.there_already_file_open: There is already a file at %s. Open it, or choose another name -- this will not write over an existing case.
server.case_open.case_refers_evidence_mo: The case refers to evidence that is not at %s. Move it back, or open the image directly and point it at this case file.
server.case_open.none_case_evidence_coul: None of this case's evidence could be opened.

server.diff.label: Diffing listings
server.diff.no_snapshot: No such snapshot in this volume's shadow copy store.
server.document.document_ceiling_reading: Document is %s; the ceiling for reading one in memory is %s.
server.document.office_document_its_cont: This is not an Office document, or its content is not present in the image.
server.ese.no_table: No table named %s in the catalog.
server.ese.truncated: Only the first %d of %d bytes were read. Tables stored past that point are incomplete or missing.
server.export.everything_here_either_fre: Everything here is either free to compute or already done. Nothing on this screen starts a scan by itself, and anything that has not been looked for says so.
server.gate.host: Refused: this request is addressed to a host name this engine does not answer to. Reach it by the address it is listening on.
server.gate.origin: Refused: this request came from another site. The Strata interface is the only thing allowed to drive this API.
server.index_relocate.detail: Copying the index into the case's cache folder, then rebuilding the case record to reclaim the space it was using. Nothing indexed is lost.
server.index_relocate.label: Moving the content index
server.journal.filesystem_journal_strata: This filesystem has no journal Strata can read.
server.leveldb.leveldb_table_log: Not a LevelDB table or log.
server.mail.no_attachment: No such attachment on this message.
server.mail.no_message: No such message in this store.
server.mail.not_pst: Not a PST — attachment content is read from PST stores only.
server.open.bad_kind: %s is not something Strata can add. Choose Image, File or Folder.
server.open.not_a_file: %s is a folder. Choose Folder to add a folder.
server.open.not_a_folder: %s is a file, not a folder. Choose File to add a single file or a zip, or Image for a disk image.
server.opened_evidence: Opened with no evidence in it.
server.pick.interface_running_same_machi: The interface is not running on the same machine as the engine, so a file dialog opened here would appear on the engine's screen. Use the built-in browser instead.

server.render.pdf_could_made_inert: This PDF could not be made inert, so it will not be rendered.

server.timeline.choose_partition_build_t: Choose a partition to build a timeline from.

server.timeline.label: Building a timeline of %s
server.timeline.not_built: No timeline has been built for this yet.
server.timeline.nothing_tagged: Nothing in this case is tagged yet, so there is nothing to build a timeline of.

server.unlock.inherited: Opened with a key supplied earlier in this session of the application, not in this case.
server.unlock.partition_encrypted_volume: That partition is not an encrypted volume this tool recognises.

server.wait_finish_cancel_task: Wait for it to finish, or cancel it in the task list.
server.whoami.examiner_name_needed_what: An examiner name is needed. It is what the audit log records against your work.
server.whoami.name_what_audit_log: This name is what the audit log will record against your work. It is not checked against anything.

vhdx.neither_vhdx_header_could: Neither VHDX header could be read.
vhdx.vhdx_active_log_so: This VHDX has an active log, so the file on disk is not current.
